newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi National Shipping Co loss widens to $20.6mln.
newsitem.headline: Saudi National Shipping Co loss widens to $20.6mln.

text.p: The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia said on Wednesday annual losses widened to 77.4 million riyals ($20.6 million) in 1996 from losses of 11.5 million riyals in 1995.

A company statement said 28 million riyals in losses were incurred by the lease of three very large crude carriers to the state-owned Saudi Aramco's shipping arm Vela International Marine last year to carry Saudi crude.
Another 24 million riyal loss resulted from an accident in which one of the company's vessels was involved at a Saudi port in March 1996, the statement said. It gave no other details.
The company, 28.8 percent owned by the Saudi government, recently took delivery of five very large crude supertankers built by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries at a cost of $400 million.
